ayahOccurrences.text: وَلَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَهُ ٱلدِّينُ وَاصِبًا ۚ أَفَغَيْرَ ٱللَّهِ تَتَّقُونَ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: وَلَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَهُ ٱلدِّينُ وَاصِبًا ۚ أَفَغَيْرَ ٱللَّهِ تَتَّقُونَ

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: وَاصِبًا is in the derivative form: وَاصِبٌ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
و/ص/ب   w–ṣ–b pain, illness, extreme fatigue; lasting, permanent; to nurse; to persist. Of this root, وَاصِبٌ wāṣib, occurs 2 times in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
وَاصِبٌ wāṣib [act. part.] lasting, constant, forever

(37:9) وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ وَاصِبٌ for them will be perpetual torment.
